No fab-sourced edge justifies a threshold change, so the stricter same-net error stays (#8938). One narrow exception (#9420): two pads of the SAME footprint on one identical non-empty net in the 2 oz pad mask-bridge check report at info (still listed). JLCDFM located by position at that pad array (#9420, 2026-11-18, one board, one export setting): the two 0.19 mm pad pairs are Good under Pad spacing (Danger 0.1 mm, Warning 0.15 mm); Soldermask bridge is empty board-wide (0 danger / 0 warning / 0 good); none of the 6 Solder mask opening exposing trace warnings is at the pads (nearest about 35 mm away); and the 19 Soldermask opening with multiple segments warnings are reinforce-wire objects (8 of the 15 top-side items located by position, 40 mm or more away; the other 11 by object type only). Since #9750 `within_own_pad` also covers a bar wider than its own pad whose copper covers the whole perimeter band (the pad's own perimeter is the allowance, so round and square pads agree) and a track entering a bare custom pad measured through its real copper outline; padstack and chamfered pads, and the own-pour class, keep their verdict. `tht_smd_spacing` (#8843) judges plated through-hole component pads plus, since #8914, vias whose drill is at least 1.0 mm (the fab classes a hole by size: the three top-side dangers kct missed on the #8914 board were all 1.3-1.42 mm wire-anchor vias). Since #8925 an anchor via is also judged against any exposed (untented) via annulus -- the fab's `smd` side counts a small exposed via pad (#8914 item 5); THT component pads are not paired with via annuli, and tented annuli are skipped (the fab's exact tenting test is unverified). Since #9325 a same-net pair of anchor-sized vias is exempt (the fab counted none of the `kct pcb reinforce` anchor pairs on the #9325 board -- one-board evidence, not a general fab-rule confirmation); a pair colliding on net 0 is not exempt (net 0 is the no-net sentinel every unconnected hole resolves to, not a shared net). Still skipped: same-footprint pad pairs and sub-1.0 mm fan-out vias as the hole side. A pad shape the rule cannot measure now reports `tht_smd_spacing_incomplete` at info instead of vanishing. Fab-view gated -- runs only when the effective --mfr is exactly `jlcpcb`. Observed 5 danger. Thresholds are 2.032 mm error / 3.05 mm warning since #9421 (were 2.0 / 2.7): the fab rated two pairs at 2.00 and 2.025 mm danger that the 2.0 mm floor passed. 2.032 mm (80 mil) is the likely real limit; the fab's "2.03" display fits either, so this is one-board evidence, not confirmed. Source: jlcdfm.com Alert value panel, read 2026-11-17/18, 4-layer, 2 oz outer copper. Same-panel values kct does not gate: via-to-pad 0.1 / 0.15 mm (danger / warning) is **not gated, observed** -- a single-board observation, and the `via_at_pad_edge` advisory already warns on that geometry, so no new rule or flag was added; pad-to-line 0.1 / 0.15 mm and mask-opening-exposing-trace 0.08 / 0.15 mm are recorded here only. `missing_plated_hole` (#8840) flags same-net top/bottom SMD pads whose centres coincide (0.05 mm) with no same-net plated hole inside both; overlapping pads with offset centres are not checked. The observed 2 warnings were not re-measured.

`silkscreen_line_width` (every silk graphic primitive) and `silkscreen_text_thickness` (text) enforce JLCPCB's published >= 0.15 mm. Not covered: JLCDFM flags silk that meets that floor (#8844: 63 warnings on gerbers with no silk stroke below 0.150 mm). How JLCDFM selects the items it flags is unknown (#8943). Text height is a separate floor: JLCPCB publishes 1.0 mm (40 mil) minimum character height (pcb-capabilities, verified 2026-11-18) and `silkscreen_text_height` enforces it; a project may declare a smaller reference-designator height (`silkscreen_min_reference_height_mm`, >= 0.8 mm, #9448) which relaxes that floor for designators only and is reported by `kct readiness` as a declared deviation -- the fab's own limit is unchanged.
